name: pick_up
text: A person stands in front of a small fallen fruit, bends the knees into a deep squat and hinges forwards. The LEFT hand reaches all the way to the fruit on the ground in front of the toes, grasps it, then the person stands upright carrying the fruit in the left hand. The right hand rests on the right thigh while squatting and relaxes afterward. Do not walk or kneel.
